brand_identity.target_audience: Foodservice operators (HORECA), food manufacturers, wholesalers/distributors, and retail private label buyers.

data.usage: Spec tables, SKUs, technical product dimensions

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-[var(--ink-900)]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32). Generous vertical rhythm.

grids.sector_cards: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6

table_ui.pattern: Horizontal scrolling for overflow, sticky headers, subtle hover state on rows (bg-ice-100).

components.cards: Flat background (white), 1px solid border (ice-300), no drop shadow by default. Hover: border-frost-500, slight translate-y-1, shadow-sm.

buttons.primary: bg-[var(--neon-500)] text-white hover:bg-[#EA580C] px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[var(--frost-900)] text-[var(--frost-900)] hover:bg-[var(--frost-900)] hover:text-white px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

components.forms: Inputs should have flat borders (border-ice-300), bg-white, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--neon-500)].

motion_and_interaction.cards: Hover lifts card slightly (transform: translateY(-4px)) and deepens border color.
motion_and_interaction.links: Underline expand on hover or color shift to neon-500.
motion_and_interaction.tables: Row background turns to ice-100 on hover for clear tracking.

images.description: Raw shrimp on ice. Use as hero background with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.
Warehouse with pallets / Wholesale distribution sector visual.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for layouts. Apply custom colors strictly as CSS variables (--frost-900, etc.) extending Tailwind config.
For components (forms, inputs), utilize Shadcn UI, customized via Tailwind config.
Hero section text MUST contrast against the dark background. Use text-white over var(--frost-900) background.
DO NOT USE INTER FOR HEADINGS. Always use Fraunces for H1, H2, H3.
Product specification tables must use JetBrains Mono to look highly professional and B2B-focused.
Build the forms as UI-only (no actual backend logic required).
Use the exact Unsplash/Pexels image URLs provided in the media section, NEVER use placeholder services like dummyimage.com.
